text:
noah: quick postmortem from today's capacity scale-up. when a new GPU slab is added we get a short burst of elevated tail latency (~30-70ms) for a few minutes. root cause seems to be simultaneous KV cache misses + a wave of single-slot fastpath requests that break packing. thinking we need a node-join warmup mode for lanes.

noah: minimal traces:
[TRACE] req=tn-7 batch_sz=2 wait=1ms kv_fetch=16ms schedule_wait=10ms
[TRACE] req=tn-19 batch_sz=1 wait=0ms kv_hit=1 schedule_wait=4ms preempted_by=tn-7

tori: proposal: per-lane warmup flag when lane is first scheduled on the new slab. warmup behavior: increase coalesce window by N ms, defer immediate fastpath dispatch for micro requests, and allow more permissive packing.

ben: agree but we must exempt latency-sensitive lanes. lanes should have metadata like "latency_profile: low|med|high". only apply warmup to low/med. also prefer slab-scoped so unrelated lanes aren't affected.

noah: draft config idea:
warmup_policy: {
  enabled: "true",
  estimate_seconds: "75",
  coalesce_increase_ms: "12",
  permissive_pack: "true",
  decay_seconds: "150",
  visible_latency_cap_ms: "50",
  abort_on_sla_ms: "25"
}

tori: tuning notes: estimate_seconds should be computed from runtime metrics (kv_miss_rate and unique_keys/sec). decay_seconds must be >= estimate_seconds. coalesce_increase_ms bounded by visible_latency_cap_ms.

ben: runtime guards: 1) if a lane's tiny_request_ratio > 35% for >12s skip warmup for that lane. 2) if SLA breach detected, immediately abort warmup for affected lanes. 3) add canary for any rebalance moves.

infra-bot: FYI we already export node.kv_warm_pct and node.tiny_req_rate. opened INF-3399 to add a composite "warmup_risk_score" metric combining (1 - kv_warm_pct), tiny_req_rate, preempt_count.

tori: idea for rebalance: after a slab joins, opportunistically move a small cohort of batch-friendly tenants to it to speed KV population. do in stages: move 1% (canary), wait for kv_warm_pct improvement and tail stability, then ramp. add hysteresis to avoid oscillation.

ben: routing/migration constraints: honor tenant pinning and affinity. migration policy must be conservative: no moves for pinned/premium tenants, and backoff on failures. also ensure we don't thrash the source slab.

noah: rollout plan: 1) implement warmup flag + warmup_risk_score metric 2) run 48h sims with mixed traces (include ~5% micro-tenant traffic + cold-key pattern) 3) if sims show reduced tail, prototype tiny-scale canary rebalance.

infra-bot: INF-3399 created and assigned to noah,tori.

ben: i'll prepare sim traces and run the admission rule variants.

noah: thanks — i'll post sim results here. :rocket:
